context: Owner request 2026-10-17: "There should be a method for tuning these platforms."
description: pg_duckdb declares PARTITIONING and CLUSTERING as supported (benchbox/platforms/pg_duckdb.py:383) but skips both at execution (pg_duckdb.py:42-43: execution_partitioning_supported = False, post_load_index_cluster_supported = False). Its DDL generator (PgDuckDBDDLGenerator) also drops CLUSTER from the preview statements. Decide the method for each table kind: CLUSTER and partitioning for heap tables (CLUSTER succeeded on a pg_duckdb plain heap table in the pgduckdb/pgduckdb:17-main image during the #3092 verification), and sort order on load for DuckDB-backed or Parquet-backed tables. Implement it with ledger evidence, and make the claimed tuning types match what is applied.
